decisions.reason: As a newly launched upholstery fabric with its own product page, it appears strategically important and inexpensive enough to keep while market acceptance becomes clearer.
Its lighter website emphasis suggests more uncertainty, but the firm's design-led breadth strategy and the low cost of leaving a decorative fabric in the collection support keeping the option open.
The product's own page and its flame-retardant functionality for contract uses fit the firm's core strengths well, so it is worth retaining while demand further reveals itself.
Because it was only briefly presented, looks more niche, and as a wool-blend product sits less neatly with the firm's push to reduce hard-to-recycle blends, it is the most expendable option.
Although still uncertain and only lightly featured, it remains close enough to the firm's premium design and more natural-material direction to justify another year on the market.
